scope: 16 authorized independently confirmed defects, not all project/audit/Store work

issues.title: Failed iOS legacy migration retains backup-eligible application plaintext
issues.correction: Exclude/verify legacy snapshot directory before listing/migration/direct read, preserve failed legacy bytes.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Foundation filesystem flag/retention tests8 plus existing safety6; actual backup/restore and Keychain-backed healthy migration not claimed.
issues.compatibility: No snapshot/encryption format or key change; OS exclusion is guidance, not never-backed-up guarantee.

issues.title: Late valid start commit can fail while sending its best-effort acknowledgement
issues.correction: Move accepted irreversible start commit outside receive timeout before separately bounded best-effort ACK; preserve caller cancellation.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Production handshake and peer coordinator under synthetic room/virtual time, not physical LAN.

issues.title: Cancellation after host advertising but before ownership return
issues.correction: Cancellation-safe ownership from synchronous kit creation through host/peer registration and transfer; cleanup unreturned rooms and exact registration in NonCancellable.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Factory9/host5/peer12/coordinator3 deterministic cases; native factory wiring source-reviewed, physical radio not measured.
issues.compatibility: Protocol4.2, credential/snapshot versions, original same-seat membership and both game authority unchanged.

issues.title: Whodunit peer readiness resubmits when command overlay removes router
issues.correction: Read current authoritative own-player readiness in remount-safe effect with session/phase/seat/generation keys.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Twelve real Compose-router tests with synthetic host/peer session controllers, not physical multiplayer.
issues.compatibility: No optimistic canonical writes, no command/revision/protocol validation relaxation.

issues.title: Xcode can continue after the Kotlin framework build fails
issues.correction: Fail actual Xcode embed shell immediately on failed cd/Gradle; normalize only after success.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Five actual shell-phase tests and three normalizer tests; not a corrected qualified-Xcode app build or diagnosis of historical launch crashes.
issues.compatibility: No application identity/signing/embedding task/version changes beyond error propagation.

issues.title: Non-Unit Jupiter tests silently omitted from discovery
issues.correction: Add explicit Unit result to10 annotated methods and actual compiled-signature discovery guard.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Eight formerly omitted enabled methods now execute; two restored disabled descriptors remain skipped along with third existing physical skip.
issues.compatibility: No assertions/ignores weakened; no physical tests enabled.

issues.title: Doctor recovery history can contradict the last resolved night
issues.correction: Bind nonterminal Doctor private previous protection to newest canonical night record regardless of repeat setting/death/history cap. Reuse existing setting and shared Mafia-only UI predicate.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Existing ON feature independently exercised across four nights; OFF restriction, skips, self flag, recovery, phase, death, caps, local resume and in-memory peer paths checked.
issues.compatibility: Existing default OFF, existing serialized flag, snapshot schema/protocol4.2 preserved; legitimate ON saves accepted, malformed mismatches rejected; host history not sent to peers.

issues.title: Active final-two Elimination snapshot accepted
issues.correction: Reject active Elimination Round/TiedRevote states with at most two living survivors; retain legitimate terminal states.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Nine strict encode/decode/local-load/own-private tests with real6-seat bundled case; no normal producer or cryptographic bypass allegation.
issues.compatibility: No schema/content/protocol version change; fail closed instead of repairing malformed state.

issues.title: Legal long player name can erase final-role text in Mafia post-game row
issues.correction: Use full-width name-over-role Column in shared Mafia final-results composable.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Six Desktop real-composable cases EN/AR,320dp,landscape,font scales1/2; native screens/readers remain separate.
issues.compatibility: Only final intentional public-role layout; no game-rule or private-state change.

issues.title: iOS Follow System can retain the app's explicit language after restart
issues.correction: Persist provenance for Parlor-owned iOS language override, reconcile application-domain prior value/absence on System/disposal/restart; update stale source-contract test and declare platform locale inputs.
issues.independent_conclusion: Ownership fix and exact four-boot app-host restart/System matrix approved within scope; legacy provenance and active-session/direct Compose/OS Settings limits remain.
issues.evidence_limits: 11 native owner tests, 13 source-contract tests and 1 actual app-host XCTest pass. Four distinct processes/14 events prove persisted AR/EN ownership before App initializes and System restoration of absence/exact prior [ar-EG,en], localized UI and native semantic direction. Observer modifies temporary Swift wrapper only. Legacy unmarked AppleLanguages provenance, identical external writes and asynchronous durability remain limited; no direct Compose direction, actual iOS Settings application, active-game identity or physical-device proof.
issues.compatibility: No session recreation or settings-schema migration; new private ownership bookkeeping does not justify deleting unowned AppleLanguages.

issues.title: reusing live-queue-derived toast IDs can hide a new notification permanently
issues.correction: Reserve distinct toast lifetimes independently of live queue and key presentation by owner+identity.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: State4/lifetime3/concurrency2 tests; Desktop timing only. Paused-frame fixture failure investigated, not hidden.
issues.compatibility: Queue4/coalescing/stale dismissal/expiry retained; bounded concurrency evidence not proof of all schedules.

issues.title: light-theme recovery Leave labels use dark text on black
issues.correction: Add CoverGhost using cover foreground for black recovery surfaces, leave ordinary Ghost unchanged.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Three actual-composable contrast cases plus focus regression; analytic pressed/disabled contrasts not physical a11y proof.
issues.compatibility: No privacy-cover/back/callback semantics or ordinary light-theme button color regression identified.

issues.title: Bundled Whodunit chronologies contain incompatible facts
issues.correction: NO FIX APPLIED: four incompatible story chronologies await specific author choices.
issues.independent_conclusion: Original defect confirmed; no safe authorial correction chosen
issues.evidence_limits: Last Dinner9:00/9:15; Layla outage9:05/9:45; Jasmine hiding duration; Khan poisoning/arrival times unresolved.
issues.compatibility: All four raw resources remain1.0.0 and byte-identical to HEAD. Later edits change canonical content digest and require explicit save/admission compatibility decision.

issues.title: Android artifact size guard mixes BSD/GNU stat output
issues.correction: Replace both BSD/GNU stat fallbacks with one strict portable Python regular-file size guard.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Seven real shell-preflight fixtures include exact/over bounds and GNU-shaped shim; not an actual Linux signed-AAB run.
issues.compatibility: Existing512MiB/10MiB bounds, digest/identity/signature safeguards preserved; publication remains disabled.

issues.title: Strict JAR verification lacks upload-certificate trust input
issues.correction: Verify each signed payload and approved leaf; validate self-signed certificate policy before ephemeral public trust, then require strict jarsigner. Separate TSA trust.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: 21 local synthetic tests including actual owned descendant cleanup; not Store credentials/signed candidate/positive RFC3161 integration.
issues.compatibility: No blanket exit4 waiver, no weak-algorithm/fingerprint/unsigned-payload bypass; Java helper is release tooling only.

issues.title: Play destination policy checked in an edit different from mutation
issues.correction: Read/validate source,destination and bundle digest within the same edit used for mutation/commit; cleanup attempted, no blind mutation retry.
issues.independent_conclusion: Approved bounded correction with executed regressions
issues.evidence_limits: Nine new production-helper mocked-HTTP tests plus complete172-test release suite; no Google Play operations.
